adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the iframe URL is built via string concatenation: `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?embed_url=" + encodeURIComponent(discourseEmbedUrl);`. If `discourseUrl` is configured without a trailing slash (e.g. `http://forum.example.com`), this produces `http://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which is an invalid path and will 404. The diff shows no normalization (e.g. ensuring a trailing `/`) or validation/error reporting in this script, so the finding’s described broken behavior is directly supported by the code.
